tailoring.headline: Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Headless & PWA APIs | Java, Spring, OCC
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, OCC REST APIs and headless commerce, designing PIM/ERP/MDM integrations and data pipelines. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning, production support and techno-functional analysis, translating business needs into robust, scalable commerce platforms across global markets.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Frontend Developer (React / Next.js) | Migración de e ...
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Convotisiberia’s ambition to modernize its commerce experience through headless and composable architectures. With over five years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in building scalable, API-first e-commerce platforms that align perfectly with your migration goals.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Cloud Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend and frontend features on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211), delivering robust product and catalog management using Java, Spring and OCC REST services.

bullets.label: Headless & API Integration
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and integrated PIM, ERP and MDM systems via DataHub and Hotfolders, enabling seamless headless commerce across multiple channels.

bullets.label: Performance & Production Support
bullets.text: I led database query refactoring and production troubleshooting, reducing latency and ensuring high availability for high-traffic B2B/B2C storefronts.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: I worked directly with international business stakeholders to translate requirements into user stories, functional specs and successful delivery within agile Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Karlsruhe, valid work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026, invitation to talk

tailoring.why_company: Convotisiberia’s focus on migrating to a headless, composable commerce stack resonates with my experience modernizing SAP Commerce Cloud platforms. I admire your commitment to leveraging Vue-based Alokai and next-gen front-ends to deliver fast, personalized shopping experiences. My background in API-first development, PIM/ERP integration and CI/CD pipelines would help accelerate your migration while ensuring stability and performance.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Convotisiberia to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud and headless commerce expertise to your migration to modern, composable front-ends, driving fast, scalable digital experiences.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years building headless e-commerce solutions at Rockwell and Shell. I’m keen to help Convotisiberia’s migration to modern front-ends. Open to discuss?
tailoring.offer: In the first months I will assess and optimize your SAP Commerce Cloud instance, implement OCC/Spartacus integrations and streamline PIM-ERP data pipelines, ensuring a smooth transition to a headless architecture. My proven CI/CD and production support experience will reduce downtime and accelerate delivery.
tailoring.insight: I see Convotisiberia is planning a migration to a headless, composable commerce architecture using Alokai. My experience delivering headless APIs and integrating PIM/ERP data will help ensure a seamless transition and rapid time-to-market.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Senior Frontend Developer – Convotisiberia
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am impressed by Convotisiberia’s move toward headless and composable commerce, and I can contribute my expertise in OCC APIs, PIM/ERP integrations and CI/CD pipelines to accelerate this transition. I also note your focus on Alokai and can support the backend integration for a smooth migration. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
